## 🌡️ MARKET OVERVIEW

**1. What is the prevailing Global Risk Regime?**
NEUTRAL. Breadth: 3/11 sectors positive; confirmations: very low sector breadth and narrow leadership (Top 5 performers are all Technology → Leadership: Narrow (5/5 Technology)), producing mixed signals between strong Tech winners and broad sector weakness.

**2. Which sectors are leading?**
Technology leads with large short-term winners: ORCL (1W: +20.62% | 1M: +27.76%) ABOVE TREND, IBM (1W: +19.76% | 1M: +34.16%) ABOVE TREND, AMAT (1W: +11.72% | 1M: +28.11%) ABOVE TREND; Energy and Materials show selective strength: VLO (1W: +8.78% | 1M: +4.40%) ABOVE TREND, FCX (1W: +11.02% | 1M: +27.12%) ABOVE TREND.

**3. Which sectors are lagging?**
Communication, Consumer Staples and Utilities are weakest: CHTR (1W: -12.35% | 1M: -21.97%) BELOW TREND, CL (1W: -7.03% | 1M: -0.59%) BELOW TREND, CEG (1W: -7.43% | 1M: -16.63%) BELOW TREND.

## 📈 STOCK PERFORMANCE

**4. Top Performing Stocks?**
Top 5: ORCL (1W: +20.62% | 1M: +27.76%) ABOVE TREND; IBM (1W: +19.76% | 1M: +34.16%) ABOVE TREND; NOW (1W: +15.45% | 1M: +28.19%) ABOVE TREND; AVGO (1W: +13.60% | 1M: +15.06%) ABOVE TREND; PANW (1W: +12.86% | 1M: +51.95%) ABOVE TREND — Leadership: Narrow (5/5 Technology).

**5. Worst Performing Stocks?**
Bottom 5: CHTR (1W: -12.35% | 1M: -21.97%) BELOW TREND; VTR (1W: -10.23% | 1M: -9.97%) BELOW TREND; EL (1W: -9.69% | 1M: +1.28%) CORRECTION; CME (1W: -9.48% | 1M: -12.97%) BELOW TREND; AMZN (1W: -8.03% | 1M: -8.10%) BELOW TREND — weakness concentrated in Communication/Real Estate/Staples.

**6. Momentum Stocks?**
Strongest 1W moves are ORCL (1W: +20.62%), IBM (1W: +19.76%), NOW (1W: +15.45%), AVGO (1W: +13.60%), PANW (1W: +12.86%) — all ABOVE TREND; major divergence present (≥3 large-cap names with 1W ≠ 1M such as AAPL, INTC, META) — watch for trend breaks and distribution.

## 🏭 SECTOR OUTLOOK

**7. Technology Outlook?**
Mixed: leadership concentrated in corporate software and semis (ORCL (1W: +20.62% | 1M: +27.76%) ABOVE TREND; AMD (1W: +9.48% | 1M: +58.85%) ABOVE TREND; NVDA (1W: +1.01% | 1M: +8.20%) ABOVE TREND) while mega-cap ad/search names are weak (GOOGL (1W: -7.67% | 1M: -6.33%) BELOW TREND, AMZN (1W: -8.03% | 1M: -8.10%) BELOW TREND) — sector breadth: positive but concentrated.

**8. Financials Outlook?**
Soft-to-mixed: large parts of the group are BELOW TREND (BLK (1W: -7.42% | 1M: -5.83%) BELOW TREND; CME (1W: -9.48% | 1M: -12.97%) BELOW TREND) while banks show tentative RECOVERY signs (JPM (1W: +0.52% | 1M: -2.21%) RECOVERY) — sector breadth: negative.

**9. Healthcare Outlook?**
Mixed/defensive but not leading: pockets of strength in biotech/news-driven names in the news; large caps show CORRECTION tendencies (LLY (1W: -0.38% | 1M: +11.64%) CORRECTION; JNJ (1W: -3.48% | 1M: +0.14%) CORRECTION) and PFE (1W: -3.32% | 1M: -2.06%) BELOW TREND — sector breadth: negative.

## 🧭 PORTFOLIO STRATEGY

**10. Portfolio Recommendation?**
Stay neutral and selective: favor Technology leaders showing ABOVE TREND momentum (ORCL (1W: +20.62% | 1M: +27.76%) ABOVE TREND, AMD (1W: +9.48% | 1M: +58.85%) ABOVE TREND) and Materials/Energy cyclicals (FCX (1W: +11.02% | 1M: +27.12%) ABOVE TREND, VLO (1W: +8.78% | 1M: +4.40%) ABOVE TREND); reduce exposure to clearly BELOW TREND Communication and certain Staples (CHTR (1W: -12.35% | 1M: -21.97%) BELOW TREND, CL (1W: -7.03% | 1M: -0.59%) BELOW TREND). Style: mixed / no clear leadership; monitor AVGO sentiment divergence.

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

**11. Stocks to Watch Next Week?**
BULLISH: ORCL (1W: +20.62% | 1M: +27.76%) ABOVE TREND, IBM (1W: +19.76% | 1M: +34.16%) ABOVE TREND, AMAT (1W: +11.72% | 1M: +28.11%) ABOVE TREND. BEARISH: GOOGL (1W: -7.67% | 1M: -6.33%) BELOW TREND, AMZN (1W: -8.03% | 1M: -8.10%) BELOW TREND, CHTR (1W: -12.35% | 1M: -21.97%) BELOW TREND.

**12. Sectors to Watch Next Week?**
BULLISH: Technology (positive but concentrated) and Energy/Materials showing cyclical lift (Breadth: 3/11 sectors positive). BEARISH: Communication, Consumer Staples and Utilities remain at risk with below-trend action.

**13. Key Levels & Triggers?**
Watch ORCL continuation after the +20% run (ORCL (1W: +20.62% | 1M: +27.76%) ABOVE TREND) for sustained breakout/mean-reversion; monitor NVDA (1W: +1.01% | 1M: +8.20%) ABOVE TREND for continuation of chip-led strength; watch GOOGL (1W: -7.67% | 1M: -6.33%) BELOW TREND and CHTR (1W: -12.35% | 1M: -21.97%) BELOW TREND for further breakdown or oversold bounces.

## 📰 NEWS SENTIMENT MOVERS

**14. Bullish Sentiment Stocks?**
Top headlines: ABBV (+80): Decnupaz approval validates ADC oncology strategy — monitor price action (no dual-timeframe in today’s price feed); ETN (+75): earnings beat and AI data-center commentary — monitor broader Industrial price confirmation; CRM (+50): AI/Anthropic momentum cited — watch price follow-through (CRM timeframe not in today's feed).

**15. Bearish Sentiment Stocks?**
AVGO (-70): headline suggests severe one-day risk but price is ABOVE TREND (AVGO (1W: +13.60% | 1M: +15.06%) ABOVE TREND) — clear negative sentiment vs strong price = divergence; SHOP (-55) and MMM (-55) carry negative headlines — cross-check price action (not in today’s detailed price feed).

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

NEUTRAL, style mixed / no clear leadership; breadth is weak (3/11) and leadership is narrow (Top 5 all Technology). ORCL (1W: +20.62% | 1M: +27.76%) and IBM (1W: +19.76% | 1M: +34.16%) are showing relative strength while GOOGL (1W: -7.67% | 1M: -6.33%) and CHTR (1W: -12.35% | 1M: -21.97%) are at risk. Key risk: major-cap divergences and sentiment/price mismatches (e.g., AVGO bearish headlines vs ABOVE TREND price) — monitor for trend confirmation before enlarging positions.
